original.statement: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (*) by default.

decision.reason: [ev-06a16cdbc869] says Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`), and that customising it is optional. Nothing in the text limits this to any particular configuration, so every environment upgrading from a version below 2.0.0 gets the default MRAP. The condition edge-from-version in-range <2.0.0 covers exactly those environments, no more and no fewer. The evidence names no setting that would protect an environment from this, so no overlap condition is needed.
